title: feat(i18n): Convention-based auto-resolution for object & field label i18n
body:
Object metadata defines labels as plain English strings (`label: 'Order Item'`), and views render them directly — bypassing existing translation files. Rather than converting ~200 labels to `I18nLabel` objects, this adds a Salesforce-style convention-based resolver that auto-constructs translation keys at render time. ### Convention The app namespace (e.g. `crm`) is **discovered dynamically** from loaded i18next resources — no app names are hardcoded in platform code. The hook scans for top-level resource keys containing `objects` or `fields` sub-keys. | What | Key pattern | Fallback | |------|------------|----------| | Object label | `{ns}.objects.{name}.label` | `objectDef.label` | | Object description | `{ns}.objects.{name}.description` | `objectDef.description` | | Field label | `{ns}.fields.{objectName}.{fieldName}` | `field.label` | ### `useObjectLabel` hook (`packages/i18n`) ```tsx const { objectLabel, objectDescription, fieldLabel } = useObjectLabel();

{objectLabel(objectDef)}

// "订单明细" in zh, "Order Item" in en ``` ### `useSafeFieldLabel` — shared safe wrapper Extracted as a shared export from `@object-ui/i18n` for plugin components that may render outside an I18nProvider context. Falls back to identity functions when no provider is available. ### Wiring - **ObjectView** — breadcrumb, page title, description, split-view drawer title - **ObjectGrid** — all three column-header paths (ListColumn, string[], auto-generated from schema) via `useSafeFieldLabel` - **ListView** — toolbar field labels (hide fields, group by, sort/filter builder, user filter derivation) via `tFieldLabel` convenience helper pre-bound with `schema.objectName` - **NavigationRenderer** — new optional `resolveObjectLabel` prop for object-type items; new optional `t` prop that translates I18nLabel objects (`{ key, defaultValue }`) through i18next for sidebar group headers, action labels, and leaf items - **AppSidebar** — passes the resolver callback and `t` function to NavigationRenderer - **All form variants** — ObjectForm, ModalForm, WizardForm, DrawerForm, TabbedForm, SplitForm all translate field labels via `useSafeFieldLabel` - **data-table.tsx** — no change needed; renders pre-built `col.header` values already translated upstream by ObjectGrid ### I18nProvider fix: app-specific translation loading The `I18nProvider` had two bugs that prevented app translations from ever being loaded into i18next: 1. **No initial load** — `loadLanguage` was only called inside `changeLanguage()`, never on mount. App translations (objects, fields, navigation) were never loaded for the initial browser language. 2. **Overly aggressive caching** — `hasResourceBundle(lang, 'translation')` returned `true` because built-in Object UI locales already existed for the language, preventing app-specific translations from being loaded even on explicit language switch. **Fix** (`packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx`): - Added `loadedAppLangs` ref to track which languages have had app-specific translations loaded (separate from built-in locales) - Added a mount `useEffect` that calls `loadLanguage` for the initial language - Replaced the `hasResourceBundle` check with `loadedAppLangs` tracking in `changeLanguage` - Added error logging and retry-on-failure (removes from tracking set on error) ### Test changes - 10 new unit tests for `useObjectLabel` (fallback, translation hit, empty string, multi-object) - Updated `@object-ui/i18n` mocks in `AppSidebar.test.tsx` and `app-creation-integration.test.tsx` to include `useObjectLabel` and `useSafeFieldLabel` - All tests pass: i18n 72, layout 78, grid 277, list 255, form 88, console 756 Zero changes to `*.object.ts` metadata files or `i18n/*.ts` translation files.
Original prompt ---- *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* Convention-based Auto-resolution for Object & Field Label i18n ### Problem CRM object and field names do not display translated labels (e.g., Chinese) even though: - Translation files (`examples/crm/src/i18n/zh.ts`) contain complete translations for all objects and fields - The i18n provider correctly loads CRM locale bundles via `/api/v1/i18n/:lang` - Navigation sidebar labels are already translated correctly **Root cause:** Object metadata files (`examples/crm/src/objects/*.object.ts`) define `label` as plain English strings, and the Console `ObjectView.tsx` renders `objectDef.label` / `field.label` directly without any i18n lookup. ```typescript // examples/crm/src/objects/order_item.object.ts — plain strings, no i18n export const OrderItemObject = ObjectSchema.create({ name: 'order_item', label: 'Order Item', // ← rendered as-is in ObjectView fields: { name: Field.text({ label: 'Line Item' }), // ← rendered as-is in table header order: Field.lookup('order', { label: 'Order' }), } }); ``` ```typescript // examples/crm/src/i18n/zh.ts — translations exist but are never consumed objects: { order_item: { label: '订单明细', description: '...' } }, fields: { order_item: { name: '订单项', order: '订单' } } ``` The naive fix would be to convert every `label` to an `I18nLabel` object (`{ key: 'crm.objects.order_item.label', defaultValue: 'Order Item' }`), but this requires ~200 manual changes across 10 objects and is hard to maintain. ### Proposed Solution: Convention-based Auto-resolution (Salesforce-style) Inspired by Salesforce's Translation Workbench, implement a **convention-based automatic translation resolver** that: 1. **Keeps object metadata unchanged** — `label` stays as a plain string (English default) 2. **Keeps translation files unchanged** — existing `zh.ts` structure is already correct 3. **Framework auto-resolves** — at render time, automatically constructs translation keys from `{objectName}` + `{fieldName}` and looks up translations #### Convention Rules | What | Auto-generated key | Fallback | |------|-------------------|----------| | Object label | `crm.objects.{objectName}.label` | `objectDef.label` (plain string) | | Object description | `crm.objects.{objectName}.description` | `objectDef.description` | | Field label | `crm.fields.{objectName}.{fieldName}` | `field.label` (plain string) | #### Implementation Plan **Step 1: New `useObjectLabel` hook in `packages/i18n`** ```typescript // packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts export function useObjectLabel() { const { t } = useObjectTranslation(); return { objectLabel: (objectDef: { name: string; label: string }) => { const key = `crm.objects.${objectDef.name}.label`; const translated = t(key, { defaultValue: '' }); return (translated && translated !== key && translated !== '') ? translated : objectDef.label; }, objectDescription: (objectDef: { name: string; description?: string }) => { if (!objectDef.description) return undefined; const key = `crm.objects.${objectDef.name}.description`; const translated = t(key, { defaultValue: '' }); return (translated && translated !== key && translated !== '') ? translated : objectDef.description; }, fieldLabel: (objectName: string, fieldName: string, fallback: string) => { const key = `crm.fields.${objectName}.${fieldName}`; const translated = t(key, { defaultValue: '' }); return (translated && translated !== key && translated !== '') ? translated : fallback; }, }; } ``` **Step 2: Wire into Console ObjectView (~3 lines)** ```tsx // apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx const { objectLabel, objectDescription } = useObjectLabel(); // Replace direct renders: -

{objectDef.label}

+

{objectLabel(objectDef)}

``` **Step 3: Wire into ListView/DataTable column headers (~10 lines)** When building columns, wrap field labels: ```typescript const columns = Object.entries(objectDef.fields).map(([fieldName, fieldDef]) => ({ ...fieldDef, label: fieldLabel(objectDef.name, fieldName, fieldDef.label), })); ``` **Step 4: Wire into NavigationRenderer for object names (~5 lines)** ### Affected Files | File | Change | |------|--------| | `packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` | **New** — convention-based resolver hook | | `packages/i18n/src/index.ts` | Export new hook | | `apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx` L701, L705, L707 | Use `objectLabel()` / `objectDescription()` | | `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | Use `fieldLabel()` for column headers | | `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` | Use `fieldLabel()` for column headers | | `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` | Use `objectLabel()` for object nav items | | `examples/crm/src/objects/*.object.ts` | **No chan...
